naive_mean_of_channel_rates.why_wrong: an unweighted mean of two channel rates weights a 2,000-visit channel the same as an 8,000-visit channel; panel 3 shows it only as a ghosted counter-example with a dashed connector, never as the answer
naive_mean_of_channel_rates.note: the overall rate is never computed this way anywhere in this deliverable

forbidden_aggregations_kept_out.absolute_conversions_as_rate: no chart encodes conversions-per-channel as a rate; absolute conversion counts appear only in the verification table as numerators

weighted_formula.overall_rate: overall_rate = sum(conversions) / sum(visits) = sum_c (w_c * r_c), where w_c = visits_c / total_visits
weighted_formula.kitagawa_decomposition: delta_R = sum_c [ (r1_c - r0_c) * (w0_c + w1_c)/2 ] + sum_c [ (w1_c - w0_c) * (r0_c + r1_c)/2 ]

late_rates_with_early_mix_80_20.meaning: 0.8*0.35 + 0.2*0.12; if the visit mix had stayed at the early 80/20 split, the later channel rates would have produced an overall rate of 30.40% instead of 16.60%

early_rates_with_late_mix_20_80.meaning: 0.2*0.30 + 0.8*0.10; with the later 20/80 mix but the early rates the overall rate would have been 14.00%

main_conclusion.statement: 两个渠道的转化率都上升了（直接访问 30.00%→35.00%，推广访问 10.00%→12.00%），但真实总体转化率从 26.00% 降到 16.60%，方向相反。

limitation.statement: 这两期两渠道的访问数与成交数只能说明分组与总体不同向这一统计事实，不能证明因果。
missing_information: 流量来源与投放时间分布
同期其他未观测的产品或市场改动
limitation.therefore: 因果结论需要额外研究设计，本图不作任何因果主张

rate_charts_1_and_3.note: both channel rates and both overall rates share one 0-100% linear scale

composition_chart_2.basis: both periods total 10,000 visits so the two bars have equal length

font_floor.note: every narrative line and every table cell is >=22px; axis ticks, legend chips, data labels and the footnote are >=18px
